description: This file defines classes and types for managing timers within the ocudu project, including timer identifiers, states, durations, and the timer_manager and unique_timer classes for creating, controlling, and handling timers. It includes external references to unique_function and task_executor, and defines symbols like timer_id_t, timer_duration, tick_point_t, timer_detail::state_t, and classes timer_manager, unique_timer, and timer_factory.

classes.name: timer_manager
classes.description: Manages application timers, including creation, destruction, starting, halting, and timeout triggering. It advances internal clock via tick() and maintains a list of unique_timers.

classes.name: unique_timer
classes.description: Represents a timer that invokes a callback upon expiration. Provides control over timer state, duration, and activity.

classes.name: timer_factory
classes.description: Creates timers associated with specific task executors.

classes.name: timer_detail::frontend_state
classes.description: Holds timer state information accessible from the front-end, including id, current state, and duration.

methods.name: timer_manager::tick
methods.description: Advances the timer manager by one tick, triggering any expired timers.

methods.name: timer_manager::create_unique_timer
methods.description: Creates a new unique_timer instance associated with a task_executor.

methods.name: unique_timer::set
methods.description: Configures the timer duration and callback for expiration.

methods.name: unique_timer::run
methods.description: Activates the timer to start ticking.
